body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> AXXEN Korea presented ''A-2500'' a 2.5-inch external HDD case during KES 2006. It is designed for a 100GB capacity HDD and it can back-up files/OS with a touch of a button.

< AVING Special Report Team for ''KES 2006'': Publisher & Editor, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Caleb Ma, Jason Lee, Gaius Park, Phoebe Kwon, Sheri Choi, Joshua Shim, Daniel Sirh, Rose Kim, Paul Kim, Samuel Kim, Abe Shim, Grace Won >
